  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      releaseTag:
        description: 'Release tag (e.g. v1.4.6-build38)'
        required: false
        default: 'v1.4.6-build38'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-apk:
    name: Build signed release APK and publish GitHub Release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: expo
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Regenerate native Android project
        env:
          CI: '1'
          EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY: '1'
        run: bunx expo prebuild --platform android --clean --no-install

      - name: Build universal release APK
        run: cd android && ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease --no-daemon -x lint

      - name: Verify APK version metadata
        run: |
          AAPT="$(ls "$ANDROID_HOME"/build-tools/*/aapt2 | sort -V | tail -1)"
          "$AAPT" dump badging android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk | head -2
          BADGING="$("$AAPT" dump badging android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk | head -1)"
          echo "$BADGING" | grep -q "versionCode='38'" || { echo "::error::versionCode is not 38"; exit 1; }
          echo "$BADGING" | grep -q "versionName='1.4.6'" || { echo "::error::versionName is not 1.4.6"; exit 1; }
          echo "$BADGING" | grep -q "name='com.ivxholdings.app'" || { echo "::error::unexpected package id"; exit 1; }

      - name: Scan bundle for secret-bearing JWTs
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/apkscan
          unzip -o -q android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk -d /tmp/apkscan
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import base64, re, sys
          data = open('/tmp/apkscan/assets/index.android.bundle', 'rb').read().decode('utf-8', 'ignore')
          bad = []
          for jwt in set(re.findall(r'eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}', data)):
              payload = jwt.split('.')[1]
              payload += '=' * (-len(payload) % 4)
              try:
                  decoded = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(payload).decode('utf-8', 'ignore')
              except Exception:
                  continue
              if '"role":"service_role"' in decoded or '"role": "service_role"' in decoded:
                  bad.append('service_role JWT found in bundle')
              if '"sub"' in decoded and '"session_id"' in decoded:
                  bad.append('user session JWT found in bundle')
          if bad:
              print('SECRET SCAN FAILED:', bad)
              sys.exit(1)
          print('Secret scan passed: no service-role or session JWTs in bundle.')
          PY

      - name: Compute checksum and rename artifact
        id: checksum
        run: |
          TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.releaseTag || 'v1.4.6-build38' }}"
          APK_NAME="ivx-holdings-${TAG}.apk"
          cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk "$APK_NAME"
          SHA256="$(sha256sum "$APK_NAME" | awk '{print $1}')"
          SIZE="$(stat -c%s "$APK_NAME")"
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "apk_name=$APK_NAME" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "sha256=$SHA256" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "size=$SIZE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "APK $APK_NAME size=$SIZE sha256=$SHA256"

      - name: Create owner-controlled GitHub Release with APK asset
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          TAG="${{ steps.checksum.outputs.tag }}"
          gh release view "$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1 && gh release delete "$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --yes --cleanup-tag || true
          gh release create "$TAG" "${{ steps.checksum.outputs.apk_name }}" \
            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --target "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --title "IVX Holdings ${TAG} (auth security release)" \
            --notes "Source commit: $GITHUB_SHA
          Package: com.ivxholdings.app
          Version: 1.4.6 (versionCode 38)
          SHA-256: ${{ steps.checksum.outputs.sha256 }}
          Size: ${{ steps.checksum.outputs.size }} bytes
          Built by GitHub Actions run ${GITHUB_RUN_ID}."
          echo "Release URL: https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tag/$TAG"
          echo "Direct APK URL: https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/download/$TAG/${{ steps.checksum.outputs.apk_name }}"
